description: IRSAD per Commonwealth electoral division per election — published tables (AEC RR5 Att1; APH 2008/2010 research papers) plus ABS-cube population-weighted derivations (ABS guidance 2039.0 §2.2).
comparability: Index definitions are recomputed each census — compare across eras via rank/decile/quartile only, never raw scores.
rankConvention: rank 1 = most advantaged (highest IRSAD score); decile/quartile ascend with disadvantage. RR5's printed ranks (1 = most disadvantaged) are re-ranked by score on ingest.
